messages:
pagerbot: [ALERT] High auth failure spike detected for api-edge-prod (us-east-1). 401 rate 12.3% (baseline ~0.8%) over 5m. Source: edge-proxy-3. Possible leak: debug-s3-forwarder reported Authorization header snippets. Pager routed to ops-oncall. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/auth-spike

ops-alex: ack — I'm oncall, joining bridge https://meet.redwood/bridge/1759991001. Pulling live logs and isolating suspect hosts.

sec-sam: seeing token reuse across >50 client_ids and many IPs. Same token fragments observed both in requests and forwarded logs. Immediate actions: rotate svc-token-prod-east, block abusive IPs at WAF, preserve S3 bundles for forensics.

infra-jen: starting rotation now. Revocation steps (internal):
```bash
# revoke old service token
redwoodctl tokens revoke --id svc-token-prod-east
# create replacement
redwoodctl tokens create --name svc-token-prod-east --scope gateways
# deploy to gateways
redwoodctl deploy tokens --name svc-token-prod-east --to edge-* --env prod
```
ETA ~6m. Pushing changes to edge-1..edge-5 in parallel.

support-mike: noted. Any customer-facing impact? I see two incoming tickets CS-7890 and CS-7891 referring to 401s. Will triage and hold templates.

cs-lee: confirmed acme-inc and beta-suite showing elevated 401s from us-east-1. Notifying account reps and preparing targeted outreach.

legal-ana: preserve logs and access lists. If any PII/exfil confirmed, escalate to compliance and retention/legal. I'll draft a short-holder notification.

sre-maya: i'll own the postmortem once we stabilize. tagging ops, sec, infra for follow-ups.

infra-jen: rotation complete — old token revoked, new token id rtk-3f9 created and pushed to gateways. Rolling restart executed on edge nodes (edge-1..5).

ops-alex: Applied WAF rule blocking top 120 abusive IPs and rate-limit rule on /v1/generate for us-east-1. 401 rate down to 1.1% within 8m. Keeping bridge open for 30m and monitoring metrics.

sec-sam: snapshots and evidence archived to secure bucket s3://redwood-incidents/1759991001/ with ACLs restricted. Commands used for snapshot:
```bash
aws s3 cp /var/log/proxy/edge-proxy-3.log s3://redwood-incidents/1759991001/ --profile incident
```
Access logged and checksums recorded.

support-mike: drafted customer-facing note and incident template (internal doc linked on bridge). Coordinating with CS for targeted outreach to acme-inc and beta-suite.

legal-ana: retention hold placed on s3://redwood-incidents/1759991001/ and related indices. Do not purge or modify until legal confirms.

sre-maya: opening postmortem doc and timeline now. Initial suspected root cause: misconfigured debug forwarder allowed Authorization header snippets into staging S3; follow-ups: audit forwarder IAM perms, sanitize log pipeline, enforce redaction on sensitive headers. Action owners assigned in doc.

ops-alex: bridge remains open 30m then transition to async updates. If error rate resurges, reopen bridge. Thanks all.

pagerbot: [UPDATE] Alert suppressed; incident marked mitigated. Monitor for recurrence and file PR for forwarder hardening. :white_check_mark:
